description: Drainage Pits is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Main Roads Western Australia. This layer shows location of drainage pits within the Metropolitan Region and is provided for information only. A Pit is defined as a node in the drainage network. It includes street gullies, side entry pits, soak wells, junction pits, and gross pollutant traps etc. Coverage: Main Roads Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are Drainage, Road Assets. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-06-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
